items.title: Google could take stake in TeraWulf’s $19B AI project
items.summary:
Google has agreed to backstop Anthropic’s $19 billion lease at bitcoin miner TeraWulf’s Kentucky data center. If Anthropic defaults, Google can take over the lease or take a stake in the project. Plus, Payward purchases AAVE tokens and Standard Chartered’s venture arm invests in Soter. CoinDesk’s Jennifer Sanasie hosts “CoinDesk Daily.”
